title: StayEase – Hotel Room Booking Landing Page

description.id: Aplikasi web pemesanan kamar hotel berbasis landing page interaktif. Dilengkapi fitur pencarian & filter reaktif real-time, kalkulasi total biaya otomatis berdasarkan durasi malam, notifikasi toast kustom, serta penyimpanan riwayat pesanan ke localStorage.
description.en: An interactive hotel room booking landing page web application. Features real-time reactive search & filtering, automated cost calculation based on night duration, custom toast notifications, and order history persistence with localStorage.

title: Aplikasi Web Monitoring Stok Sparepart ATM Luar Kota

description.id: Aplikasi web yang dibangun dari awal (from scratch) untuk mencatat, memantau, dan mengelola ketersediaan stok sparepart ATM luar kota secara real-time. Membantu inventarisasi unit luar kota menjadi lebih terstruktur dan efisien.
description.en: A web application built from scratch to record, track, and manage out-of-town ATM spare part inventory in real time. Helps standardize and streamline inventory operations.

title: SPK & Monitoring Penerima Rastrada Menggunakan TOPSIS

description.id: Sistem Informasi Pendukung Keputusan dan Pemantauan berbasis web menggunakan framework Laravel dan metode TOPSIS. Dirancang untuk menentukan kelayakan serta memantau penyaluran bantuan Beras Sejahtera Daerah (Rastrada) secara efisien dan transparan.
description.en: A web-based Decision Support and Monitoring System using the Laravel framework and TOPSIS method, designed to evaluate eligibility and transparently track regional welfare aid distribution.

title: SewaPro – Studio Booking & Photography Equipment Rental System

description.id: Aplikasi web manajemen sewa studio fotografi dan alat yang dilengkapi pencegahan double-booking, live countdown timer batas bayar DP 50%, operasional check-out/in verifikasi KTP fisik, serta pemantauan keterlambatan secara otomatis.
description.en: A photography studio and equipment rental management system featuring double-booking prevention, a live 50% DP payment countdown timer, physical ID check-in/out verification, and automated delay tracking.
